text:
maria_su: Heads-up — Ticket #4521 from Acme (via CSM) reporting a large billing variance. Dashboard usage for 2026-03-08 shows 1,214,330 tokens but invoice INV-2026-03-08-ACME billed 1,923,880 tokens. Customer is disputing the difference and asking for an expedited credit/refund. attaching screenshot and export link: https://internal.redwood/usage/exports/uid1234 :slightly_frowning_face:

billing-bot: Created billing case BLG-987 and attached invoice INV-2026-03-08-ACME. Usage export available at https://internal.redwood/usage/exports/uid1234.csv. Case owner assigned: jim_f.

jim_f: Thanks. Can someone paste the exported CSV snapshot here or run a quick aggregation? I want total tokens by request_id and any obvious duplicates. Also need the invoice line item and amount to estimate refund.

sandeep: Quick note — we saw a spike last month caused by streaming reconnects that emitted duplicate metering events. If customer had flaky connections + reconnects that could double-count tokens. Do we have request ids or sample timestamps to check?

maria_su: Customer sent sample request ids: req_aa1, req_bb7, req_cc3. They reported seeing 429s and then reconnects around 14:05 UTC. Log snippet they provided:

```
2026-03-08T14:05:23Z req=req_aa1 event=stream_open
2026-03-08T14:05:24Z req=req_aa1 event=stream_reconnect attempt=1
2026-03-08T14:05:24Z req=req_aa1 event=token_emitted count=156
2026-03-08T14:05:24Z req=req_aa1 event=token_emitted count=156
```

maria_su: They also attached their client logs showing a retry loop.

ingrid: That log looks like duplicate metering events — two identical `token_emitted` events for the same request and same second. Metering-service v2 dedupes by `event_id`, but streaming reconnects didn't always include the same event_id on reconnect. I opened PR #3052 to add deterministic event_id generation on reconnect path. Hotfix queued.

sandeep: Ok, action plan suggestion: 1) run a recount/dedupe job for that invoice window using (request_id + token timestamp + count) heuristics, 2) compute delta, 3) if delta > threshold, issue a credit memo for the delta and create revrec note. I can run the recount job if ops gives greenlight.

jim_f: Greenlight. Maria, confirm customer preference for credit vs invoice rewrite. We need their sign-off to proceed with credit memo. Also give me the expected amount range so finance can pre-approve.

maria_su: Customer prefers a credit to speed things up and avoid reissuing. They want it processed ASAP.

billing-bot: Recount job started: job_jb_772. ETA ~2 hours. Output will be posted to https://internal.redwood/usage/recounts/job_jb_772.csv and case BLG-987 updated.

[some time passes]

sandeep: Recount finished. Summary: original invoice tokens = 1,923,880; deduped tokens = 1,214,330; delta = 709,550 tokens. Calculated credit = $423.73 (using hosted API token rates). Recount job id job_jb_772, output link: https://internal.redwood/usage/recounts/job_jb_772.csv. Root cause: duplicate metering events correlated with streaming reconnects for ~3% of requests in that window.

jim_f: Finance approves credit. Please create the credit memo and journal entry: JE-2026-00345 and CM-2026-ACME-01 for $423.73. Update invoice INV-2026-03-08-ACME as adjusted and add revrec note. Suggested revrec language: "Metering dedupe adjustment per support case #4521 — non-recurring correction due to duplicate streaming metering events; credit issued for overcounted tokens."

maria_su: Will create the credit memo and notify customer immediately. I'll include the recount CSV and the revrec note in the message. Customer acknowledged and said thanks. :thumbsup:

ingrid: Follow-up engineering item: add alert when streaming reconnects >5/min for a single customer and ensure reconnect path sets event_id. I'll link PR #3052 to the incident and schedule a rollback window if needed.

jim_f: Finance task checklist: create JE, apply CM, update invoice metadata, confirm tax impact (none expected), file revrec memo. I'll mark BLG-987 as resolved once CM applied.

maria_su: Closing loop with customer now. Will post the confirmation email when sent. Thanks team! :tada:
